summary.text: Phil Green is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 67 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Phil Green's general-election opponent is Leslie Getz (D).
He has worked as a minister and has served on the House Appropriations Committee in most terms since 2019.

paragraphs.text: Phil Green was born and lives in Millington, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree in youth ministries and a master's degree in Biblical expositions from Pensacola Christian College.
His career experience includes working as a minister, and he has served on the board of the Michigan Coalition for Responsible Gun Owners.

Green assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023, and was assigned to the House Appropriations Committee in 2019-2020, 2023-2024, and 2025-2026, and to the Education Committee in 2021-2022.
